nazov_en: Ready for an internet and power outage

poznamka: Každá položka má zdroje s adresou, doslovným citátom a dátumom overenia. Ceny sú orientačné k dátumu overenia. Bez provízií a bez platených miest.

uvod.text_sk: Bez elektriny nebeží router, počítač ani offline AI v počítači. Telefón vydrží, kým má batériu. Preto majte nabité powerbanky: podľa [BBK](https://www.bbk.bund.de/DE/Warnung-Vorsorge/Vorsorge/In-der-Krise-informiert-sein/in-der-krise-informiert-sein_node.html) nimi pri výpadku nabijete mobil alebo notebook. Spotrebiče a elektroniku počas výpadku odpojte, aby ich pri návrate prúdu nepoškodilo prepätie ([Ready.gov](https://www.ready.gov/power-outages)).
uvod.text_en: Without electricity there is no router, no computer and no offline AI on a computer. A phone lasts as long as its battery. So keep power banks charged: according to [BBK](https://www.bbk.bund.de/DE/Warnung-Vorsorge/Vorsorge/In-der-Krise-informiert-sein/in-der-krise-informiert-sein_node.html), they let you charge a phone or laptop during an outage. Unplug appliances and electronics during the outage so a surge does not damage them when the power returns ([Ready.gov](https://www.ready.gov/power-outages)).

zdroje.citat: Mit einer Powerbank können Sie zum Beispiel Ihr Mobiltelefon oder einen Laptop bei Stromausfall laden.
Es kommt kein Wasser mehr aus der Leitung und Internet und Mobilfunk sind gestört.
Disconnect appliances and electronics to avoid damage from electrical surges.

uvod.nadpis_sk: Internet nie je to isté ako hovor
uvod.nadpis_en: Internet is not the same as a call
uvod.text_sk: Výpadok môže zasiahnuť len niektoré siete, alebo všetky ([britská vláda](https://beready.campaign.gov.uk/be-informed-about-hazards/phone-broadband-outages/)). Keď je sieť preťažená, SMS potrebujú menej kapacity a prejdú spoľahlivejšie než hovor ([Ready.gov](https://www.ready.gov/get-tech-ready)). Spoľahnúť sa na to nedá.
uvod.text_en: An outage might affect only certain networks, or all of them ([UK government](https://beready.campaign.gov.uk/be-informed-about-hazards/phone-broadband-outages/)). When the network is overloaded, text messages need less bandwidth and get through more reliably than calls ([Ready.gov](https://www.ready.gov/get-tech-ready)). You cannot count on it.

zdroje.citat: An outage might affect only certain networks or it could affect all networks.
Text messages require less bandwidth, which means they are able to be transmitted more reliably during situations when many people are trying to use their mobile phones at the same time.

uvod.text_sk: Podľa [BBK](https://www.bbk.bund.de/DE/Warnung-Vorsorge/Vorsorge/Stromausfall/stromausfall_node.html) sa výpadky elektriny spravidla odstránia za niekoľko hodín, pri rozsiahlych škodách to však môže trvať aj dni. Pri úplnom blackoute v Španielsku 28. 4. 2025 bolo do 7:00 nasledujúceho dňa obnovených 99,95 % spotreby ([Red Eléctrica](https://www.ree.es/en/press-office/news/press-release/2025/04/red-electrica-response-to-the-incident-of-28-april)).
uvod.text_en: According to [BBK](https://www.bbk.bund.de/DE/Warnung-Vorsorge/Vorsorge/Stromausfall/stromausfall_node.html), power outages are usually fixed within a few hours, but with widespread damage it can take days. In the total blackout in Spain on 28 April 2025, 99.95% of demand was restored by 7:00 the next day ([Red Eléctrica](https://www.ree.es/en/press-office/news/press-release/2025/04/red-electrica-response-to-the-incident-of-28-april)).

zdroje.citat: In der Regel werden Stromausfälle in wenigen Stunden behoben.
Aber es kann in Notsituationen mit großflächigen Schäden durchaus auch einmal Tage dauern, bis der Strom wieder verfügbar ist.
On 28 April 2025, at 12:33 CEST, the power systems of continental Spain and Portugal experienced a total blackout.
Thus, by 7:00 AM on 29 April, 99.95% of the demand had been restored.

uvod.text_sk: Pri výpadku ľudia kúria a varia náhradnými zdrojmi. Oxid uhoľnatý nevidíte ani necítite a môže zabiť ([CDC](https://www.cdc.gov/natural-disasters/response/what-to-do-protect-yourself-during-a-power-outage.html)). Gril, kempingový varič ani generátor nepatria do bytu a sviečky nenechávajte horieť bez dozoru. Podrobnosti sú v časti [Gril, varič, generátor a plyn](#plyn-gril-v-byte).
uvod.text_en: In an outage people heat and cook with alternative sources. Carbon monoxide cannot be seen or smelled and can kill ([CDC](https://www.cdc.gov/natural-disasters/response/what-to-do-protect-yourself-during-a-power-outage.html)). Grills, camping stoves and generators do not belong indoors, and never leave candles burning unattended. Details are in [Grills, stoves, generators and gas](#plyn-gril-v-byte).

zdroje.citat: Carbon monoxide (CO) is an odorless, colorless gas that can cause sudden illness and death if inhaled.
Never use a charcoal grill, hibachi, lantern, or portable camping stove inside a home, tent, or camper.
Always stay near lit candles.

kontrolny_zoznam_72h.text_sk:
Voda pre každého na tri dni. Na pitie počítajte najmenej 2 litre na osobu a deň ([72h.gov.cz](https://www.72h.gov.cz/cs/voda)); [MV SR](https://www.minv.sk/?co-robit-v-pripade-krizy-alebo-ozbrojeneho-konfliktu) odporúča uchovať 3 až 5 litrov pitnej vody na osobu a deň a pri blackoute aspoň 4 litre (2 na pitie a 2 na varenie a hygienu). S hygienou a varením spotreba podľa [72h.gov.cz](https://www.72h.gov.cz/cs/voda) dosahuje 10 až 15 litrov denne. Najbezpečnejšia je neotvorená balená voda ([CDC](https://www.cdc.gov/water-emergency/about/how-to-create-and-store-an-emergency-water-supply.html)) a 72h.gov.cz radí piť len balenú vodu alebo vodu z pristavených cisterien.

Ak si vodu skladujete sami, nepoužívajte nádoby od chemikálií, napríklad od bielidla alebo postrekov ([CDC](https://www.cdc.gov/water-emergency/about/how-to-create-and-store-an-emergency-water-supply.html)). Nádobu pred naplnením umyte mydlom a dôkladne vypláchnite. Potom ju vydezinfikujte roztokom, ktorý je len na nádobu, nie na pitie: do litra vody dajte asi 5 ml chlórového bielidla bez vône, ktoré obsahuje 5 až 9 % chlórnanu sodného (dávka je náš prepočet z amerických jednotiek). Roztok nalejte do nádoby, tesne ju zatvorte a dobre pretrepte, aby roztok obmyl celé vnútro. Aspoň po pol minúte roztok vylejte a prázdnu nádobu nechajte vyschnúť na vzduchu ([CDC](https://www.cdc.gov/water-emergency/about/how-to-create-and-store-an-emergency-water-supply.html)). Ak si nie ste istí kvalitou vody, prevarte ju ([MV SR](https://www.minv.sk/?co-robit-v-pripade-krizy-alebo-ozbrojeneho-konfliktu)).
kontrolny_zoznam_72h.text_en:
Water for everyone for three days. For drinking, count on at least 2 litres per person per day ([72h.gov.cz](https://www.72h.gov.cz/cs/voda)); the [Slovak Ministry of Interior](https://www.minv.sk/?co-robit-v-pripade-krizy-alebo-ozbrojeneho-konfliktu) recommends keeping 3 to 5 litres of drinking water per person per day, and for a blackout at least 4 litres (2 for drinking and 2 for cooking and hygiene). With hygiene and cooking, use reaches 10 to 15 litres a day according to [72h.gov.cz](https://www.72h.gov.cz/cs/voda). Unopened bottled water is the safest ([CDC](https://www.cdc.gov/water-emergency/about/how-to-create-and-store-an-emergency-water-supply.html)), and 72h.gov.cz says to drink only bottled water or water from emergency tankers.

If you store water yourself, never use containers that held chemicals such as bleach or pesticides ([CDC](https://www.cdc.gov/water-emergency/about/how-to-create-and-store-an-emergency-water-supply.html)). Before filling a container, wash it with soap and rinse it thoroughly. Then sanitize it with a solution that is only for the container, not for drinking: mix about 5 ml of unscented liquid household chlorine bleach containing 5 to 9% sodium hypochlorite into a litre of water (the amount is our conversion from US units). Pour the solution into the container, close it tightly and shake it well so the solution reaches every inside surface. After at least 30 seconds pour the solution out and let the empty container air-dry ([CDC](https://www.cdc.gov/water-emergency/about/how-to-create-and-store-an-emergency-water-supply.html)). If you are not sure about the water quality, boil it ([Slovak Ministry of Interior](https://www.minv.sk/?co-robit-v-pripade-krizy-alebo-ozbrojeneho-konfliktu)).

zdroje.citat: Na jednu osobu sa odporúčajú minimálne 4 litre vody denne (2 litre na pitie a 2 litre na varenie a hygienu).
Každý z nás spotřebuje přibližně dva litry čisté pitné vody denně.
Přičteme-li k tomu vodu nezbytnou k zajištění osobní hygieny a vaření, její celková spotřeba dosahuje k 10 až 15 litrům denně.
K pití používáme pouze balenou vodu nebo vodu z přistavených cisteren.
Use clean containers to collect and store your water.
Nouzově si dospělý člověk vystačí se dvěma litry vody denně.
Uchovajte si 3-5 litrov pitnej vody na osobu denne; v prípade potreby vodu prevarte.
Unopened, commercially bottled water is the safest and most reliable source of water in an emergency.
Wash the storage container with soap and rinse completely with water.
Sanitize the container with a solution made by mixing 1 teaspoon of unscented liquid household chlorine bleach in 1 quart (4 cups) of water.
Use bleach that contains 5%-9% sodium hypochlorite.
Cover the container tightly and shake it well. Make sure the sanitizing bleach solution touches all inside surfaces of the container.
Wait at least 30 seconds and then pour the sanitizing solution out of the container.
Let the empty container air-dry before use.
Do not use containers that were previously used to hold liquid or solid toxic chemicals, such as bleach or pesticides.

For a blackout, the [Slovak Ministry of Interior](https://www.minv.sk/?co-robit-v-pripade-krizy-alebo-ozbrojeneho-konfliktu) recommends food for the whole household for at least 14 days.

kontrolny_zoznam_72h.text_sk: Lekárnička a potrebné lieky na týždeň ([72h.gov.cz](https://www.72h.gov.cz/cs/nouzove-zasoby)). [MV SR](https://www.minv.sk/?co-robit-v-pripade-krizy-alebo-ozbrojeneho-konfliktu): lekárnička, obväzy, dôležité lieky a lieky, ktoré vám predpísal lekár. Ak užívate lieky, ktoré treba chladiť, alebo používate zdravotnícky prístroj na elektrinu, dohodnite si vopred s lekárom, čo robiť pri výpadku ([Ready.gov](https://www.ready.gov/power-outages)). Podľa [CDC](https://www.cdc.gov/natural-disasters/response/what-to-do-protect-yourself-during-a-power-outage.html) lieky, ktoré majú byť v chladničke, po dni a viac bez prúdu vyhoďte, ak ich obal neuvádza inak; ak od takého lieku závisí život a liek bol pri izbovej teplote, používajte ho len dovtedy, kým nezískate nové balenie, a všetky chladené lieky čo najskôr nahraďte. Sledujte dátum exspirácie a lieky majte mimo dosahu detí ([MV SR](https://www.minv.sk/?co-robit-v-pripade-krizy-alebo-ozbrojeneho-konfliktu)). Prvú pomoc sa naučíte na [kurze Slovenského Červeného kríža](https://redcross.sk/kurz-prvej-pomoci-8-hodin/); adresár ju nenahrádza.
kontrolny_zoznam_72h.text_en: A first aid kit and the medicines you need for a week ([72h.gov.cz](https://www.72h.gov.cz/cs/nouzove-zasoby)). [Slovak Ministry of Interior](https://www.minv.sk/?co-robit-v-pripade-krizy-alebo-ozbrojeneho-konfliktu): first aid kit, bandages, important medicines and your prescribed medicines. If you take medicines that must be refrigerated or use a medical device that runs on electricity, agree a power outage plan with your doctor in advance ([Ready.gov](https://www.ready.gov/power-outages)). According to the [CDC](https://www.cdc.gov/natural-disasters/response/what-to-do-protect-yourself-during-a-power-outage.html), when the power is out for a day or more, throw away medicines that should be refrigerated unless the label says otherwise; if a life depends on such a medicine and it has been at room temperature, use it only until a new supply is available, and replace all refrigerated medicines as soon as possible. Check expiry dates and keep medicines out of children's reach ([Slovak Ministry of Interior](https://www.minv.sk/?co-robit-v-pripade-krizy-alebo-ozbrojeneho-konfliktu)). Learn first aid on a [Slovak Red Cross course](https://redcross.sk/kurz-prvej-pomoci-8-hodin/) (in Slovak); this directory is no substitute.

Have alternate plans for refrigerating medicines or using power-dependent medical devices.
Talk to your medical provider about a power outage plan for medical devices powered by electricity and refrigerated medicines.
When the power is out for a day or more, throw away any medication that should be refrigerated, unless the drug's label says otherwise.
If a life depends on the refrigerated drug, but the medications have been at room temperature, use them only until a new supply is available.
Replace all refrigerated drugs as soon as possible.

kontrolny_zoznam_72h.text_sk: Baterka alebo čelovka pre každého člena domácnosti ([Ready.gov](https://www.ready.gov/power-outages)) a náhradné batérie ([MV SR](https://www.minv.sk/?co-robit-v-pripade-krizy-alebo-ozbrojeneho-konfliktu)). Americké [CDC](https://www.cdc.gov/natural-disasters/response/what-to-do-protect-yourself-during-a-power-outage.html) odporúča baterky namiesto sviečok, aby sa znížilo riziko požiaru.
kontrolny_zoznam_72h.text_en: A torch or headlamp for every household member ([Ready.gov](https://www.ready.gov/power-outages)) and spare batteries ([Slovak Ministry of Interior](https://www.minv.sk/?co-robit-v-pripade-krizy-alebo-ozbrojeneho-konfliktu)). The US [CDC](https://www.cdc.gov/natural-disasters/response/what-to-do-protect-yourself-during-a-power-outage.html) recommends battery lights rather than candles to minimise the risk of fire.

zdroje.citat: Have flashlights for every household member.
Pripravte si náhradné osvetlenie: LED svetlá, sviečky, zapaľovače, baterky s náhradnými batériami, čelovka, petrolejová baterka.
Use battery-powered flashlights and lanterns, rather than candles, gas lanterns, or torches to minimize the risk of fire.

kontrolny_zoznam_72h.text_en: A battery radio with spare batteries ([Slovak Ministry of Interior](https://www.minv.sk/?co-robit-v-pripade-krizy-alebo-ozbrojeneho-konfliktu)). According to [BBK](https://www.bbk.bund.de/DE/Warnung-Vorsorge/Vorsorge/In-der-Krise-informiert-sein/in-der-krise-informiert-sein_node.html), radio stations keep broadcasting in an outage, and car or crank radios work too.

kontrolny_zoznam_72h.text_sk:
Teplé oblečenie a deky, spacák alebo teplá deka pre každého. Podľa [BBK](https://www.bbk.bund.de/DE/Warnung-Vorsorge/Vorsorge/Stromausfall/stromausfall_node.html) zostaňte pokiaľ možno v jednej miestnosti a dvere držte zatvorené, aby neunikalo teplo, no aj tak pravidelne vetrajte, najmä keď svietite sviečkami. Aj [MV SR](https://www.minv.sk/?co-robit-v-pripade-krizy-alebo-ozbrojeneho-konfliktu) radí miestnosť pravidelne vetrať. Plynovým sporákom, grilom ani generátorom v byte nekúrte a plynový ohrievač používajte len s bezpečnostnými poistkami. V kachliach ani krbe, ktoré nemajú odvod spalín, nič nepáľte a nevarte na nich ([CDC](https://www.cdc.gov/carbon-monoxide/about/index.html)).

Podľa [vyhlášky MV SR č. 401/2007 Z. z.](https://static.slov-lex.sk/pdf/SK/ZZ/2007/401/ZZ_2007_401_20070901.pdf) sa komín, do ktorého sú pripojené spotrebiče na tuhé alebo kvapalné palivá s celkovým tepelným výkonom do 50 kW, musí počas prevádzky čistiť a kontrolovať najmenej raz za štyri mesiace. Ak komín od posledného čistenia a kontroly nebol v prevádzke dlhšie než tieto štyri mesiace, musí sa skontrolovať a vyčistiť skôr, než v spotrebiči znova zatopíte. Upchatý komín môže spôsobiť, že sa v dome či v byte nahromadí oxid uhoľnatý ([CDC](https://www.cdc.gov/carbon-monoxide/about/index.html)). O oxide uhoľnatom viac v časti [Gril, varič, generátor a plyn](#plyn-gril-v-byte).

Warm clothes and blankets, a sleeping bag or warm blanket for everyone. According to [BBK](https://www.bbk.bund.de/DE/Warnung-Vorsorge/Vorsorge/Stromausfall/stromausfall_node.html), stay in one room if possible and keep the doors closed so warmth does not escape, but still ventilate regularly, especially if you use candles. The [Slovak Ministry of Interior](https://www.minv.sk/?co-robit-v-pripade-krizy-alebo-ozbrojeneho-konfliktu) also says to air the room regularly. If the heat or cold is extreme, go to a community location with power ([Ready.gov](https://www.ready.gov/power-outages)).

Do not heat a flat with a gas stove, a grill or a generator, and use a gas heater only with its safety devices. Do not burn anything in a stove or fireplace, or cook on it, if it is not vented ([CDC](https://www.cdc.gov/carbon-monoxide/about/index.html)).

Under [Slovak Ministry of Interior Decree No. 401/2007 Coll.](https://static.slov-lex.sk/pdf/SK/ZZ/2007/401/ZZ_2007_401_20070901.pdf), a chimney connected to solid or liquid fuel appliances with a total heat output of up to 50 kW must be cleaned and inspected at least once every four months while in use. If the chimney has not been in use for longer than those four months since its last cleaning and inspection, it must be inspected and cleaned before you light the appliance again. A blocked chimney can let carbon monoxide build up indoors ([CDC](https://www.cdc.gov/carbon-monoxide/about/index.html)). More on carbon monoxide in [Grills, stoves, generators and gas](#plyn-gril-v-byte).

pasce.nadpis_sk: Gril, varič, generátor a plyn: oxid uhoľnatý v byte
pasce.nadpis_en: Grills, stoves, generators and gas: carbon monoxide indoors
pasce.text_sk:
Oxid uhoľnatý je plyn bez farby a zápachu, ktorý môže spôsobiť náhlu chorobu a smrť ([CDC](https://www.cdc.gov/natural-disasters/response/what-to-do-protect-yourself-during-a-power-outage.html)). Najčastejšie príznaky otravy sú bolesť hlavy, závrat, slabosť, nevoľnosť, zvracanie, bolesť na hrudi a zmätenosť; kto spí, môže zomrieť skôr, než sa príznaky objavia. Ak má niekto príznaky, CDC radí hneď volať tiesňovú linku alebo lekára; na Slovensku je to 112 alebo záchranná služba 155 ([MV SR](https://www.minv.sk/?co-robit-v-pripade-krizy-alebo-ozbrojeneho-konfliktu)).

Nikdy nekúrte v byte plynovým sporákom ani rúrou. Generátor ani iný benzínový motor nepúšťajte v byte, pivnici ani garáži, ani keď sú dvere a okná otvorené; patrí len von, viac než 20 stôp (asi 6 m, náš prepočet) od okien, dverí a vetracích otvorov ([CDC](https://www.cdc.gov/carbon-monoxide/about/index.html)). Nemecký [BBK](https://www.bbk.bund.de/DE/Warnung-Vorsorge/Vorsorge/Stromausfall/stromausfall_node.html): negrilujte v byte ani v dome.

Slovenský návod [MV SR](https://www.minv.sk/?co-robit-v-pripade-krizy-alebo-ozbrojeneho-konfliktu) uvádza ako náhradné zdroje tepla aj plynové alebo parafínové ohrievače, upozornenie na oxid uhoľnatý sme tam však nenašli. Plynový ohrievač používajte len vtedy, keď má poistku proti nedostatku kyslíka a zapaľovaciu poistku, a k tomu detektor oxidu uhoľnatého ([BBK](https://www.bbk.bund.de/DE/Warnung-Vorsorge/Vorsorge/Stromausfall/stromausfall_node.html)). Petrolejový (parafínový) ohrievač patrí do dobre vetranej miestnosti, ďalej od záclon a horľavých vecí; nádrž nepreplňajte a ohrievač má mať termostat a vypnúť sa sám, keď spadne ([Ready.gov](https://www.ready.gov/home-fires)). Tankujte doň len palivo, ktoré predpisuje výrobca, a riaďte sa jeho návodom ([CDC](https://www.cdc.gov/natural-disasters/response/what-to-do-protect-yourself-during-a-power-outage.html)); americký Ready.gov uvádza číry petrolej K-1. Drevené uhlie v byte nepáľte a prenosné chemické ohrievače bez plameňa v byte nepoužívajte ([CDC](https://www.cdc.gov/carbon-monoxide/about/index.html)).
pasce.text_en:
Carbon monoxide is an odourless, colourless gas that can cause sudden illness and death ([CDC](https://www.cdc.gov/natural-disasters/response/what-to-do-protect-yourself-during-a-power-outage.html)). The most common symptoms of poisoning are headache, dizziness, weakness, nausea, vomiting, chest pain and confusion; people who are asleep can die before they have any symptoms. If someone shows symptoms, the CDC says to call emergency services or a health professional right away; in Slovakia that is 112 or the ambulance on 155 ([Slovak Ministry of Interior](https://www.minv.sk/?co-robit-v-pripade-krizy-alebo-ozbrojeneho-konfliktu)).

Never heat a home with a gas range or oven. Never run a generator or any petrol engine inside a home, basement or garage, even with doors and windows open; use it only outside, more than 20 feet (about 6 m) from windows, doors and vents ([CDC](https://www.cdc.gov/carbon-monoxide/about/index.html)). The German [BBK](https://www.bbk.bund.de/DE/Warnung-Vorsorge/Vorsorge/Stromausfall/stromausfall_node.html): do not grill in a flat or house.

The Slovak [Ministry of Interior guide](https://www.minv.sk/?co-robit-v-pripade-krizy-alebo-ozbrojeneho-konfliktu) lists gas or paraffin heaters as alternative heat sources, but we found no carbon monoxide warning there. Use a gas heater only if it has an oxygen depletion safety device and a flame failure device, and add a carbon monoxide detector ([BBK](https://www.bbk.bund.de/DE/Warnung-Vorsorge/Vorsorge/Stromausfall/stromausfall_node.html)). A paraffin (kerosene) heater belongs in a well ventilated room, away from curtains and anything flammable; never overfill it, and the heater should have a thermostat and switch off by itself if it falls over ([Ready.gov](https://www.ready.gov/home-fires)). Use only the fuel its maker specifies and follow the maker's instructions ([CDC](https://www.cdc.gov/natural-disasters/response/what-to-do-protect-yourself-during-a-power-outage.html)); the US site Ready.gov names crystal clear K-1 kerosene. Never burn charcoal indoors and do not use portable flameless chemical heaters indoors ([CDC](https://www.cdc.gov/carbon-monoxide/about/index.html)).

pasce.text_sk: [CDC](https://www.cdc.gov/natural-disasters/response/what-to-do-protect-yourself-during-a-power-outage.html) odporúča baterky a lampy na batérie namiesto sviečok, plynových lámp a fakieľ, aby sa znížilo riziko požiaru. Ak sviečky predsa používate, nenechávajte ich horieť bez dozoru ([CDC](https://www.cdc.gov/natural-disasters/response/what-to-do-protect-yourself-during-a-power-outage.html)), držte ich aspoň 12 palcov (asi 30 cm, náš prepočet) od horľavých vecí a deti pri nich nenechávajte samé ([Ready.gov](https://www.ready.gov/home-fires)). [MV SR](https://www.minv.sk/?co-robit-v-pripade-krizy-alebo-ozbrojeneho-konfliktu) radí pred spaním zhasnúť všetky sviečky a náhradné zdroje vykurovania.
pasce.text_en: The [CDC](https://www.cdc.gov/natural-disasters/response/what-to-do-protect-yourself-during-a-power-outage.html) recommends battery flashlights and lanterns rather than candles, gas lanterns or torches to minimise the risk of fire. If you do use candles, always stay near them ([CDC](https://www.cdc.gov/natural-disasters/response/what-to-do-protect-yourself-during-a-power-outage.html)), keep them at least 12 inches from anything flammable and never leave children alone near them ([Ready.gov](https://www.ready.gov/home-fires)). The [Slovak Ministry of Interior](https://www.minv.sk/?co-robit-v-pripade-krizy-alebo-ozbrojeneho-konfliktu) says to put out all candles and alternative heat sources before sleeping.

zdroje.citat: Use battery-powered flashlights and lanterns, rather than candles, gas lanterns, or torches to minimize the risk of fire.
Always stay near lit candles.
Keep candles at least 12 inches away from flammable materials or consider using flameless candles.
Never leave children unattended near operating stoves or burning candles, even for a short time.

pasce.nadpis_en: The fridge does not last long
pasce.text_sk: Podľa [CDC](https://www.cdc.gov/food-safety/foods/keep-food-safe-after-emergency.html) ostane jedlo v chladničke bez prúdu bezpečné 4 hodiny, zamrazené 48 hodín v plnej a 24 hodín v polovične plnej mrazničke. Dvierka držte zatvorené. Po 4 hodinách bez prúdu a bez chladenia vyhoďte z chladničky mäso, ryby, nakrájané ovocie a zeleninu, vajcia, mlieko a zvyšky jedál. Bezpečnosť jedla neskúšajte ochutnaním; pri pochybnostiach ho vyhoďte. [MV SR](https://www.minv.sk/?co-robit-v-pripade-krizy-alebo-ozbrojeneho-konfliktu): najskôr použite potraviny z chladničky.
pasce.text_en: According to the [CDC](https://www.cdc.gov/food-safety/foods/keep-food-safe-after-emergency.html), food stays safe in a fridge without power for 4 hours, frozen food 48 hours in a full freezer and 24 hours in a half full one. Keep the doors closed. After 4 hours without power or another cold source, throw out meat, fish, cut fruit and vegetables, eggs, milk and leftovers from the fridge. Never taste food to check whether it is safe; when in doubt, throw it out. [Slovak Ministry of Interior](https://www.minv.sk/?co-robit-v-pripade-krizy-alebo-ozbrojeneho-konfliktu): use food from the fridge first.

zdroje.citat: Food will last in a fridge for 4 hours without power.
Frozen food will last 48 hours in a full freezer and 24 hours in a half-full freezer.
Keep refrigerator and freezer doors closed.
When in doubt, throw it out!
najskôr použite potraviny z chladničky
Throw out perishable food in your refrigerator (meat, fish, cut fruits and vegetables, eggs, milk, and leftovers) after 4 hours without power or without a cold source like ice.
Never taste food to know if it is safe to eat.

pasce.nadpis_en: The mobile network has no unlimited backup
pasce.text_sk: Pri výpadku elektriny môžu byť internet aj mobilná sieť rušené ([BBK](https://www.bbk.bund.de/DE/Warnung-Vorsorge/Vorsorge/Stromausfall/stromausfall_node.html)). Španielska vláda po blackoute plánuje povinnosť, aby batérie udržali mobilné pokrytie štyri hodiny pre 75 % obyvateľov ([La Moncloa](https://www.lamoncloa.gob.es/serviciosdeprensa/notasprensa/transformacion-digital-y-funcion-publica/paginas/2026/250626-cobertura-movil-apagon.aspx)). Údaj pre slovenské siete sme nenašli.

After its blackout, the Spanish government plans a rule that batteries keep mobile coverage for four hours for 75% of the population ([La Moncloa](https://www.lamoncloa.gob.es/serviciosdeprensa/notasprensa/transformacion-digital-y-funcion-publica/paginas/2026/250626-cobertura-movil-apagon.aspx)). otazky.otazka_sk: Funguje pri výpadku elektriny internet a mobil?
otazky.otazka_en: Do internet and mobile work during a power outage?
odpoved_sk: Nemusia. Nemecký úrad civilnej ochrany píše, že pri výpadku elektriny môžu byť internet aj mobilná sieť rušené ([BBK](https://www.bbk.bund.de/DE/Warnung-Vorsorge/Vorsorge/Stromausfall/stromausfall_node.html)). Britská vláda dodáva, že výpadok môže zasiahnuť len niektoré siete, alebo všetky ([Be Ready](https://beready.campaign.gov.uk/be-informed-about-hazards/phone-broadband-outages/)).
Keď je sieť preťažená, SMS prejdú spoľahlivejšie než hovor ([Ready.gov](https://www.ready.gov/get-tech-ready)). Rozhlas podľa BBK vysiela aj pri výpadku, preto majte rádio na batérie alebo kľuku.
odpoved_en: Not necessarily. The German civil protection office says internet and the mobile network can be disrupted in a power outage ([BBK](https://www.bbk.bund.de/DE/Warnung-Vorsorge/Vorsorge/Stromausfall/stromausfall_node.html)). The UK government adds that an outage might affect only certain networks, or all of them ([Be Ready](https://beready.campaign.gov.uk/be-informed-about-hazards/phone-broadband-outages/)).

When the network is overloaded, text messages get through more reliably than calls ([Ready.gov](https://www.ready.gov/get-tech-ready)). According to BBK, radio keeps broadcasting in an outage, so keep a battery or crank radio.

zdroje.citat: Es kommt kein Wasser mehr aus der Leitung und Internet und Mobilfunk sind gestört.
An outage might affect only certain networks or it could affect all networks.
Text messages require less bandwidth, which means they are able to be transmitted more reliably during situations when many people are trying to use their mobile phones at the same time.
Radiosender funktionieren aber auch dann noch.

otazky.otazka_sk: Koľko vody a jedla mám mať doma?
otazky.otazka_en: How much water and food should I keep at home?
odpoved_sk: Na pitie najmenej 2 litre na osobu a deň. [MV SR](https://www.minv.sk/?co-robit-v-pripade-krizy-alebo-ozbrojeneho-konfliktu) odporúča uchovať 3 až 5 litrov pitnej vody na osobu a deň, pri blackoute aspoň 4 litre (2 na pitie a 2 na varenie a hygienu) a jedlo pre celú domácnosť aspoň na 14 dní. Česká [72h.gov.cz](https://www.72h.gov.cz/cs/jidlo) uvádza jedlo aspoň na 72 hodín a nemecký [BBK](https://www.bbk.bund.de/DE/Warnung-Vorsorge/Vorsorge/So-koennen-Sie-sich-vorbereiten/Bevorraten/bevorraten_node.html) zásoby pokiaľ možno na desať dní.
Cieľ EÚ je sebestačnosť aspoň 72 hodín ([Európska komisia](https://commission.europa.eu/topics/preparedness_en)). Náš kontrolný zoznam vychádza z týchto 72 hodín.
odpoved_en: At least 2 litres of drinking water per person per day. The [Slovak Ministry of Interior](https://www.minv.sk/?co-robit-v-pripade-krizy-alebo-ozbrojeneho-konfliktu) recommends keeping 3 to 5 litres of drinking water per person per day, and for a blackout at least 4 litres (2 for drinking and 2 for cooking and hygiene) and food for the whole household for at least 14 days. The Czech [72h.gov.cz](https://www.72h.gov.cz/cs/jidlo) says food for at least 72 hours, and the German [BBK](https://www.bbk.bund.de/DE/Warnung-Vorsorge/Vorsorge/So-koennen-Sie-sich-vorbereiten/Bevorraten/bevorraten_node.html) supplies for ten days if possible.
The EU goal is self-sufficiency for at least 72 hours ([European Commission](https://commission.europa.eu/topics/preparedness_en)). Our checklist is built around those 72 hours.

zdroje.citat: Na jednu osobu sa odporúčajú minimálne 4 litre vody denne (2 litre na pitie a 2 litre na varenie a hygienu).
Měli bychom mít proto zásoby jídla aspoň na 72 hodin.
Sie sollten sich für möglichst zehn Tage selbst versorgen können.
develop guidelines to reach a population self-sufficiency of minimum 72 hours
Uchovajte si 3-5 litrov pitnej vody na osobu denne; v prípade potreby vodu prevarte.

otazky.otazka_sk: Potrebujem na vysielačky alebo Meshtastic povolenie?
otazky.otazka_en: Do I need a licence for walkie talkies or Meshtastic?
odpoved_sk: Na vysielačky PMR446 nie: na Slovensku ich môže používať každý podľa všeobecného povolenia [VPR-08/2022](https://www.teleoff.gov.sk/files/urad/odbory-oddelenia/odbor-spravy-frekvencneho-spektra/sprava-frekvencii-regulacia/vseobecne-povolenia/53556_zverejnenie_vpr-08-2022_pmr446.pdf), s výkonom najviac 500 mW a len ručné stanice s integrovanou anténou.

Ani rádiá LoRa (Meshtastic, MeshCore) v pásme 869,4 až 869,650 MHz nepotrebujú individuálne povolenie: platí všeobecné povolenie [VPR-02/2022](https://www.teleoff.gov.sk/files/urad/odbory-oddelenia/odbor-spravy-frekvencneho-spektra/sprava-frekvencii-regulacia/vseobecne-povolenia/53552_zverejnenie_vpr-02_2022_n-srd.pdf), ktoré oprávňuje každú osobu na Slovensku, s výkonom najviac 500 mW e.r.p.; Meshtastic v EÚ navyše dodržiava limit 10 % času vysielania ([Meshtastic](https://meshtastic.org/docs/configuration/radio/lora/)). Rádioamatérska stanica naopak potrebuje [individuálne povolenie po skúške](https://www.teleoff.gov.sk/urad/odbory-oddelenia/odbor-spravy-frekvencneho-spektra/skusky-osobitnej-odbornej-sposobilosti/amaterska-radiokomunikacna-sluzba/radioamaterskevysielanie/).
odpoved_en: Not for PMR446 walkie talkies: in Slovakia anyone may use them under general authorisation [VPR-08/2022](https://www.teleoff.gov.sk/files/urad/odbory-oddelenia/odbor-spravy-frekvencneho-spektra/sprava-frekvencii-regulacia/vseobecne-povolenia/53556_zverejnenie_vpr-08-2022_pmr446.pdf), at no more than 500 mW and only as handheld units with an integrated antenna.

LoRa radios (Meshtastic, MeshCore) in the 869.4 to 869.650 MHz band need no individual licence either: general authorisation [VPR-02/2022](https://www.teleoff.gov.sk/files/urad/odbory-oddelenia/odbor-spravy-frekvencneho-spektra/sprava-frekvencii-regulacia/vseobecne-povolenia/53552_zverejnenie_vpr-02_2022_n-srd.pdf) covers everyone in Slovakia, at no more than 500 mW e.r.p.; in the EU Meshtastic also keeps to a 10% duty cycle ([Meshtastic](https://meshtastic.org/docs/configuration/radio/lora/)). An amateur radio station, by contrast, needs an [individual licence after an exam](https://www.teleoff.gov.sk/urad/odbory-oddelenia/odbor-spravy-frekvencneho-spektra/skusky-osobitnej-odbornej-sposobilosti/amaterska-radiokomunikacna-sluzba/radioamaterskevysielanie/).

zdroje.citat: Rádiové zariadenia je povolené prevádzkovať iba ako ručné pohyblivé stanice s integrovanou anténou.
na používanie frekvencií pri prevádzkovaní nešpecifikovaných rádiových zariadení s krátkym dosahom určených na prenos dátových, hovorových a iných signálov
Zriadenie a prevádzkovanie amatérskej rádiostanice je možné len na základe platného individuálneho povolenia na používanie frekvencií.
Všeobecné povolenie oprávňuje každú osobu na území Slovenskej republiky
`EU_433` and `EU_868` are limited to a 10% duty cycle, calculated every minute over a rolling hour.

otazky.otazka_sk: Ako sa pri výpadku dozviem, čo sa deje?
otazky.otazka_en: How will I find out what is happening during an outage?
odpoved_sk: Z rozhlasu: stanice podľa [BBK](https://www.bbk.bund.de/DE/Warnung-Vorsorge/Vorsorge/In-der-Krise-informiert-sein/in-der-krise-informiert-sein_node.html) vysielajú aj pri výpadku a funguje autorádio, rádio na kľuku alebo na batérie.
Poznajte signály sirén. [MV SR](https://www.minv.sk/?co-robit-v-pripade-krizy-alebo-ozbrojeneho-konfliktu) radí sledovať informácie a dodržiavať pokyny. Signály sú v časti [Signály sirén](#sireny).
odpoved_en: From the radio: according to [BBK](https://www.bbk.bund.de/DE/Warnung-Vorsorge/Vorsorge/In-der-Krise-informiert-sein/in-der-krise-informiert-sein_node.html), stations keep broadcasting in an outage, and car, crank or battery radios work.

Know the siren signals. The [Slovak Ministry of Interior](https://www.minv.sk/?co-robit-v-pripade-krizy-alebo-ozbrojeneho-konfliktu) says to follow information and instructions. The signals are in the [Siren signals](#sireny) section.
